notes.f1: The death record supports the event, but not the identity. The elder João, baptised in 1839, married in 1865, and documented alive in 1905, was not considered. The report assigns the 1919 death to the 1851 João and fails to resolve the central identity conflict. Proof quality 1: it overstates the identity match as confident, calls the extract an original civil registration, and wrongly claims no competing candidate was identified.
